descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-02 step 4 + ER; TFA-92580 How it works 4 · “the app shows "N patients are already on your list" with an "add only the new ones" option”.

Decision D15 · S1 · Daniela

Overlapping scan: TFA-92580 AC 5 and the UAT ask for one step 'N patients are already on your list, add only the new ones'; the app (like prototype p72) asks about each overlapping patient one by one (Hospital 'Possible duplicates … Same patient / Different') or shows 'N already · N new · N to review' (Nursing Home), with no add-only-new step. Which one? (Q1; AC 1 'match p72' and AC 5 disagree)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-02/S12

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S11 Hospital day-2 overlapping scan: 'N already on your list', add only the new ones, nothing overwritten, no silent merge or duplicate

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. … (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5; TFA-92580 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U5 An overlapping scan leaves existing patients' data untouched. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • T2 Silent, backend-only logging: every patient add tagged Scan or Manual, every patient removed or discharged, and every duplicate prompt as shown, accepted or rejected. … (TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Local stack. Seeded through the backend before the agent starts, the way a day-1 scan of h-day1-clean.png stores them (same server day, standing in for day 2; the day-1 scan itself is S01): 401 QA Alder 71 Heart failure 300101, set to New Admission, pre-round text 'QA-PR-ALDER seeded pre-round marker', open task 'QA-T …

When Scan h-day2-overlap.jpg and confirm, then choose to add only the new patients. If the app asks row by row instead, answer: QA Alder (MRN 300101) and QA Cedar (no MRN) are the same patient; the QA Birch with MRN 300199 is a different patient

Then The app says 2 patients are already on the list (QA Alder by name + MRN, QA Cedar by name only; Q7) and offers to add only the new ones. The QA Birch with MRN 300199, a different person with the same name, is never counted as already on the list without asking and is never dropped: it ends up as a second QA Birch chart in room 407, or the app asked about it …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints. The overlap checkpoint needs the UAT wording ('2 patients are already on your list' and 'only the new'; exact wording is Q1). The chart checkpoints prove nothing was overwritten: room, diagnosis, badge, pre-round text and tasks (Q7 for the room). The required backend checks (spec.backendChecks) decide 'no silent merge or duplicate' and T2. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (mocked day-2 rows)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (patientActivity log check local); Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S11

Hospital day-2 overlapping scan: 'N already on your list', add only the new ones, nothing overwritten, no silent merge or duplicate

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Local spec pl-tc02-local.spec.ts 'TC-02 S11'. Seeded Alder (401, Heart failure, 300101, New Admission, pre-round 'QA-PR-ALDER…', task 'QA-TASK-ALDER…'), Birch (402, COPD, 300102, task), Cedar (403, AKI, 300103); read answered with h-day2-overlap's 5 rows (Alder 409 'Heart failure, improving' 300101; Birch 52 Gout flare 300199; Cedar no MRN; Dogwood 405; Elm 406). Judged 15/16. FAILED (U4, Q1): there is no '2 patients are already on your list … add only the new ones' step: the sheet says nothing about overlap ('5 patients found', all ticked); after Add the app shows per-row questions ('Possible duplicates — A patient with this name is already on your list. You decide…', one card each for QA Alder 'Same name and MRN' and QA Cedar 'Same name (no DOB or MRN…)', buttons 'Same patient (don't add)' / 'Different — add anyway'). This is p72's design word for word (Q1 asks which design is accepted). Held: answering 'same' for Alder and Cedar adds nothing for them; the Birch with MRN 300199 was not asked about and was added as a second QA Birch in room 407 (accepted by the then); Dogwood and Elm added at Follow-up; counts Alder 1 / Birch 2 / Cedar 1 / Dogwood 1 / Elm 1; Alder keeps Room 401, 'Heart failure', MRN, New Admission (chart select), its pre-round text and its task, no Room 409 / 'improving'; Birch 402 keeps COPD and its task (chart); Cedar keeps 403 and MRN 300103; Dogwood's chart Room 405 at Follow-up; activity: 2 duplicate_prompt_shown each with exactly one accepted, 3 patient_added scan_census, no name / MRN / diagnosis in any row. Recorded: a same-name row with a different MRN is added without asking (Q7: an MRN misread would duplicate the chart).

Product issue: On an overlapping re-scan the physician is not told how many are already on the list and has no 'add only the new ones' option; each overlap is asked one by one (prototype design, Q1).

Evidence: 9 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient, synthetic-media, oracle-controls, backend-read-admin, lane-b-scan-ai. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
